Package ui

Class ReservationScreen

java.lang.Object
ui.ReservationScreen
public class ReservationScreen extends Object
JavaFX controller for the Reservation Management screen (ReservationScreen.fxml).

This screen allows hotel staff to:

  • Book a suite — enter guest ID, suite ID, check-in and check-out dates, then submit to create a new reservation. The DAO performs an overlap check and computes the total cost automatically.
  • Cancel a reservation — enter a reservation ID to permanently delete the reservation and all its associated experience records.
  • Browse available suites — a live card grid showing every suite in the system along with its next available date (or "Available now").
  • View existing reservations — a table of all reservations in the database.

The controller is instantiated and injected by the JavaFX FXMLLoader when ReservationScreen.fxml is loaded.

    • loadSuites

      private void loadSuites() throws SQLException
      Fetches all suites with their availability status and rebuilds the suite card grid.

      Each suite is rendered as a VBox card containing:

      • Suite number (large, Georgia font via CSS)
      • Hotel name
      • Suite ID
      • Availability badge — green "Available now" or red "Available from: <date>"
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database query fails

    • bookSuite

      private void bookSuite()
      Handles the "+ BOOK SUITE" button action.

      Validates all input fields before attempting the booking:

      • Both dates must be selected.
      • Check-in must not be in the past.
      • Check-out must be strictly after check-in.
      • Guest ID and Suite ID must be positive integers.

      On success, the form is cleared and both the suite grid and reservation table are refreshed. The DAO handles the overlap check and total cost calculation. Any booking conflict surfaces as a SQLException with a descriptive message shown to the user.

    • clearBook

      private void clearBook()
      Handles the "CLEAR" button action on the New Reservation form. Resets all booking input fields to their empty/null state.

    • cancelReservation

      private void cancelReservation()
      Handles the "X CANCEL RESERVATION" button action.

      Validates that a numeric reservation ID has been entered, then calls ReservationDAO.cancelReservation(int) which deletes the reservation and all its associated experience records. Refreshes both the suite grid and the reservation table on success.
